metadata.question: Was the water extent at the River Nene larger, specifically 5 km radius around (53.083908, -0.819876) on January 4,2024 than on January 5, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Location: 5km radius around (53.083908, -0.819876) - River Nene in UK - Dates: January 4, 2024 vs January 5, 2022 - Data: Need water detection. JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-2 with water detection would be good. - I'll use Sentinel-2 with NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) for water detection. 2. Masking Strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get accurate water detection - Use Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. Logic: - Calculate water extent for both dates using NDWI > 0 threshold - Compare the water pixel counts - Handle cases where no data or insufficient pixels Let me use Sentinel-2 with cloud masking and NDWI calculation. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-0.819876, 53.083908]); const geometry = point.buffer(5000); // 5km radius const date1 = '2024-01-04'; const date2 = '2022-01-05'; // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to get and process water extent for a date function getWaterExtent(date) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) return {count: 0, images: 0}; const image = collection.first(); // Calculate NDWI for water detection const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Water mask (NDWI > 0 typically indicates water) const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0); // Count water pixels const waterCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); return {count: waterCount || 0, images: size}; } // 2. Data Acquisition & Processing const water2024 = getWaterExtent(date1); const water2022 = getWaterExtent(date2); // 3. Output stats console.log(`2024-01-04: Images=${water2024.images}, WaterPixels=${water2024.count}`); console.log(`2022-01-05: Images=${water2022.images}, WaterPixels=${water2022.count}`); // 4. Check for empty collections if (water2024.images === 0 || water2022.images === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Check for no valid pixels if (water2024.count === 0 || water2022.count === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 6. Check for calculation failure if (water2024.count === null || water2022.count === null || isNaN(water2024.count) || isNaN(water2022.count)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Compare water extents if (water2024.count > water2022.count) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
